verdict.summary: The change is a research-only design record and is internally consistent with its stated scope. It clearly distinguishes schema emission from execution, corrects the dependency premise to include GraphView metadata access, treats SHACL-to-GraphQL projection as lossy, identifies naming and execution-hardening risks, preserves opt-in/core-lean expectations, and avoids unverified performance claims. Its source references for the public model/view surface, absent presentation metadata, fallible property-path conversion, and lack of an existing GraphQL endpoint are consistent with the checkout. No implementation or public API is changed, so implementation tests are not required by this PR.
